title: Remove extension lists for magic-number open routines.
description:
They are not used, and, if filled in, become one more place to worry
about "is this out of sync"?

This whole mechanism of maintaining three lists of information about
capture file types needs to be claed up; the biggest prblem is that the
open_info array currently needs a lot of hand curation to make sure that
the weak AF heuristics (I'm nooking at *you*, .vwr raw capture reader!)
are run as late as possible.
